title: The Secret Homecoming
author: Sebastian Blackwood
blurb: Petra Joubert, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
